== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Officer Evax (Japanese)|Officer Evax]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/tcg/company-sets/1997-decipher-star-wars-ccg-new-hope-limited-japanese/imagegallery/587873 Robert John's Japanese Hoth PSA showcase], [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/157709594/63Jcs9hHbUS0iccjkCqijw.jpg source photograph], PSA certificate 90960098.

Crop rectangle <code>(145, 620, 1290, 2220)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>c56dda89b3f7f12359cd293192e4afa59fa5d707d9880e5de90e4eec2e011db6</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
